parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington is down 2027-03-16 to 2027-03-18. 9 production orders were moved with 9 rescheduled at the same plant, 32 dealers notified once each for 79 customer orders, and 18 loaners assigned.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on confirmed plant_outage incident after ids and dates resolved against the data, rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live schedule baseline matched before the first write.
